subject: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@finserv.io>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globalpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots

Hi Ella and Rajiv —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Thanks for the thoughtful questions about latency SLAs and multi-tenant isolation. As discussed, next step is a product demo + technical deep dive (30–45m) with our infra/solutions engineer so we can map the architecture to your procurement checklist.

To keep things fair across your global team, I wanted to propose a rotating schedule of demo slots so the same stakeholders don't always meet outside business hours. Below are three weekly slot blocks covering US / EU / APAC windows — please pick your preferred slot for next week or tell me which rotation you'd like:

Option A — US-friendly (rotate weeks into EU/APAC)
- Tue 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (Tue 18:00 CET / Wed 01:00 SGT)

Option B — EU-friendly
- Wed 09:00 AM CET / Wed 03:00 AM ET (Tue 00:00 PT)

Option C — APAC-friendly
- Thu 10:00 AM SGT / Wed 10:00 PM ET / Wed 7:00 PM PT

If it helps, we can set a recurring weekly slot and rotate the host time each week (US → EU → APAC). I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and SOW templates for procurement context.

Proposed attendees for the technical deep dive:
- Rajiv Singh (GlobalPay) — technical lead
- Ella Thompson (GlobalPay) — product
- Aditya Rao (Redwood) — solutions engineer (I’ll loop him in once we lock a slot)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — AE (renewal/ops lead)

Next steps: 1) pick a slot or suggest alternatives; 2) confirm attendees; 3) I’ll send a calendar invite + Miro link.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
Attachments: Mutual Action Plan v1.pdf; SOW-templates.zip

From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globalpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ella Thompson <ella@finserv.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T12:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots

Camila — thanks for the follow-up and the MAP. Helpful. Quick callout on availability: for next week, our core engineering group can do

- Tue 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT) — good for US folks
- Thu 9:00 AM GMT+1 (10:00 AM CET) — ok for London team but not for SGT folks

If we rotate, we prefer the first rotation to be US-friendly so our US ops lead can join. Also happy to have a short pre-demo sync with Aditya if he wants to review network requirements beforehand.

Would pick Option A for next week. Please include Aditya for the technical deep dive.

Thanks,
Rajiv
VP, Platform Engineering | GlobalPay

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globalpay.com>, Ella Thompson <ella@finserv.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots

Thanks Rajiv — Appreciate the clear preference. Option A (Tue 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET) works well.

A couple of practical items before I send the invite:
- Confirmed attendees: Rajiv, Ella, Aditya Rao (solutions), Marissa Cole (AE) — anyone else to add?
- Duration: 45 minutes (30m demo + 15m Q&A/next steps)
- Pre-demo packet: I’ll drop a short network checklist for Aditya to review — quick answer on IP allowlist and KMS integration should be enough.

If that’s green, I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue at the US-friendly time and mark the recurrence as weekly with a rotating host (US → EU → APAC). We can keep it as an optional recurrence so attendees can opt out of rotations that conflict with local hours.

Also copying our Solutions Engineer when I send the invite so he can attach the network checklist.

—Camila

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globalpay.com>, Ella Thompson <ella@finserv.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots

Adding Aditya here — hi @Aditya, we plan to run the first demo Tue 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (45m). Can you please: 1) review the MAP in the thread and flag any immediate blockers; 2) share a 1–2 line network checklist we can include in the invite; 3) be prepared to cover autoscaling/quantization questions.

Aditya — if you want a quick 15m sync before Tue to align on deep-dive priorities, happy to set that up.

Camila — please go ahead and send the invite; I’ll follow up on procurement items if they confirm the rotation cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@globalpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Thompson <ella@finserv.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T09:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Demo & technical deep dive — rotating time slots

Sounds good — we confirm Option A for Tue 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET. Please send the calendar invite and include the network checklist.

Quick ask: can you make the recurrence weekly but label the next two occurrences as US / EU respectively so stakeholders know the rotation plan? We’ll decide on APAC week after the first two runs.

Appreciate it — looking forward.

Best,
Rajiv
VP, Platform Engineering | GlobalPay
